primaryPurple.role: Primary brand color — buttons, active states, CTA, brand moments

deepPurple.role: Deep purple — hover/focus states, active gradient endpoints

lavender.role: Lavender — secondary accents, badges, highlights, focus rings

softLavender.role: Soft lavender — subtle background tint, active item chips, table hover

primaryText.role: Primary high-contrast text for headings, titles, key numbers

secondaryText.role: Secondary medium-contrast text for body descriptions and metadata

surface.role: Elevated card surface, modal dialogs, popovers

softBackground.role: Base page soft background, alternate section fills

success.role: Confirmed tips, verified badges, connected status

warning.role: Pending webhooks, low token balance notice, warnings

error.role: Failed payments, validation errors, critical alerts
